bodyBrief: Existing chibi face/proportions and frontal seated pose. Official calico cat sleep mask, blonde twin tails with black bows, blue eyes, black choker and halter straps, wide white off-shoulder neckline with orange ruffles, black/white bow with gold cat-paw center and orange pompom. Upper body and short upper arms only, no forearms/hands or furniture. Preserve native transparent gaps.
handsBrief: Three columns matching previous hand atlas. Rounded pale bare forearm shaft; left keyboard hand with thumb viewer-left; right hand on ivory/orange mouse with thumb viewer-right. Identical palm scale, white scrunchies, five digits, no gloves or blue sleeves. Transparent RGBA.
desk: Classic: cream/blue keycaps and light-blue cat-ear mouse mat. Dorm: cream/orange keycaps and warm-orange cat-ear mouse mat. Both use rounded padded desk, paw emblem and stitched edge. Keycap geometry, 180-degree orientation and target coordinates preserved.
alpha: Original generated RGBA preserved; no global white removal.
